noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

dependencies.description: Path to fields that this function is interested in

grainPath.description: Path to field that contains the grain

timeRangeStartPath.description: Path to field that contains the timeRangeStart

timeRangeEndPath.description: Path to field that contains the timeRangeEnd

title:
Application-driven calculations through callbacks.
 The callback function's signature should be:
   type T { ... foo : function(T t, [UpdatedDependency] updatedDependencies) }
 If this annotation is not defined on a function that has this signature,
 the annotation will be ignored.
 If the dependency path does not contain a reference to an entity type,
 that dependency will be ignored.
 The callback function is called when the value pointed to by one or more
 dependency changes. If the dependency is a timeseries, the callback would be
 invoked AFTER normalization. If grainPath or timeRangeStartPath or timeRangeEndPath
 is specified, the call is invoked only if the change satisfies all the specified conditions i.e.
   1. the change impacted a complete grain
   2. the change was after the specified start time
   3. the change was before the specified end time

The callback is invoked under the following circumstances:
   1. When the value of the dependency changes
      If the dependency is a reference to a timeseries, the UpdatedDependency Obj will
      contain the affected TimeRange.
   2. When the reference to the dependency changes
      e.g. if the dependency is devices.measurements, the following changes will lead to the callback:
      A. devices changes i.e. a new device got added or a device got removed
      B. devices.measurements changes i.e. a new measurement series got added or a measurement series got removed
      In this case, the callback will point to the changed Object but the TimeRange value will not be set.
name: Ann.TimeseriesCallbackFunction
